# Cabivella

> Cabivella presents made-to-measure cabinetry design collections for UK homeowners and trade professionals. Detailed specifications, manufacturing arrangements, delivery and availability are confirmed during each individual enquiry.

This directory lists reviewed, publicly available information pages. Product details, availability, delivery and quotations are confirmed directly with Cabivella.

## Main

- [Cabivella | Kitchens, Bathrooms & Made-to-Measure Cabinetry](https://cabivella.co.uk/): Explore cabinetry design collections and enquire about kitchens, bathrooms, pantries and fitted storage.

## Collections

- [Cabinetry Collections](https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/): Browse kitchen, bathroom and storage cabinetry categories.
- [Kitchen Cabinetry](https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/kitchens/): See kitchen design directions and enquire about layout and finishes.
- [Bathroom Furniture](https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/bathrooms/): View bathroom vanity and storage design directions.
- [Pantry and Larder Cupboards](https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/pantry-larder/): Explore kitchen storage and larder cabinetry.
- [Coffee Station Cabinets](https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/coffee-stations/): Explore coffee storage and breakfast cupboard design options.
- [Fitted Storage](https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/fitted-storage/): Explore fitted wardrobes and utility storage designs.
- [Replacement Kitchen Doors](https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/kitchen-doors/): Explore replacement doors and cabinet fronts.

## Company

- [For Trade Professionals](https://cabivella.co.uk/trade/): Cabinetry enquiry route for architects, interior designers and fitters.
- [Our Story](https://cabivella.co.uk/our-story/): Learn about Cabivella's approach to design and cabinetry sourcing.
- [Enquire About a Project](https://cabivella.co.uk/enquire/): Contact Cabivella about a made-to-measure cabinetry project.

## Policies

- [Privacy Notice](https://cabivella.co.uk/privacy/): How enquiry information is handled.
